mechanism_claims.claim_text: Clavanin A and clavanin-MO show direct antibacterial activity in MIC assays, with clavanin-MO generally lower MIC values than clavanin A in Table 1.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=2:Antibacterial activity profile of peptides; xml:table=1

mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC activity proves antibacterial phenotype, not a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Clavanin A and clavanin-MO modulate innate immune responses by increasing IL-10, suppressing IL-12/TNF-alpha in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells, and promoting leukocyte recruitment/cytokine release in mice.
direct_assay_types: RAW264.7 cytokine ELISA after LPS stimulation
peritoneal cytokine ELISA in infected mice

mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism accepted for host immune modulation only; no receptor-level target is identified.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Clavanin-MO decreases K. pneumoniae KPC971 biofilm biomass in flow-cell assays but does not fully eradicate tested biofilms and MRSA biofilm is relatively unaffected.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No full eradication and no exact biofilm biomass values are asserted from local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Structural/membrane simulations suggest the FLPII tag enhances hydrophobic-core affinity, while TLC assays show no ppGpp reduction; the paper does not establish a direct membrane-disruption or ppGpp mechanism for killing.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=2; xml:sec=3; supplement Fig. S2/S3 captions; pdf_text lines 118-124 and 304-309

mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational membrane affinity and negative ppGpp data are retained as context, not promoted to direct killing mechanism.

mechanism_summary: Worker-6 source review accepts antimicrobial phenotype and host-immunomodulatory mechanism evidence with scope guards; membrane and ppGpp evidence are not overpromoted.

caution_findings.note: Direct mechanism is limited to immune-modulation assays. Antibacterial activity remains phenotype-supported; membrane and ppGpp data do not define the killing target.
